rules.name: Unusually Large Transfer
rules.description: Single transaction debit amount exceeds 3x the customer's 6-month average debit
rules.action: Flag for review — verify with customer if intentional

rules.name: New Payee Burst
rules.description: Two or more payments to a payee not seen in the prior 5 months of history, within 10 days
rules.action: Escalate to investigator — potential account takeover or scam

rules.name: Odd Hours Activity
rules.description: Transaction initiated between 01:00 AM and 05:00 AM local time
rules.action: Note in report — correlate with other flags

rules.name: Pattern Break — Amount
rules.description: Debit amount exceeds the customer's 90th percentile historical debit by more than 2x
rules.action: Flag for review — check if customer initiated or authorised

rules.name: New Channel Anomaly
rules.description: Transaction via a payment channel not used by this customer in prior history
rules.action: Note in report — may indicate device compromise or social engineering
